column3: MT 8:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. Close to the Hebrew; “who set Your splendor” is rendered “Who have displayed Your splendor.”
Close to the Hebrew; “an avenger” is rendered “the revengeful.”
Close to the Hebrew; “when I see” is rendered “When I consider.”
Close to the Hebrew; “humankind” is rendered “man.”
